articles.title: Armored Dino Found in Japan May Have Walked from Alaska!
articles.summary: Scientists found a new armored dinosaur in Japan. It may have walked there from North America across an ancient land bridge. Only three of its kind have ever been found in Asia.

articles.title: A Comet from Another Star System May Hold Clues to Life
articles.summary: A comet called 3I/ATLAS came from outside our solar system. Scientists found organic molecules on it — the same kind that help build life. It's only the third interstellar object ever spotted.

articles.title: Jupiter: The Giant Planet That Could Hold 1,300 Earths
articles.summary: Jupiter is the biggest planet in our solar system. It's a gas giant with no solid surface, a 300-year-old hurricane, and nearly 70 moons. One of its moons might even hide life.
